arcadialoren: The draft reached P-F7 on Day 11. Walter Arcadialoren was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Walter Arcadialoren helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Walter Arcadialoren was hit in the forearm at P-F7. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Dorian "Spark" Cody of the Concord (@cody13g). A letter from home found Walter Arcadialoren before the night shift. Walter Arcadialoren folded it small and kept it close.
The medic looked at Walter Arcadialoren's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to P-F7. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
Walter Arcadialoren carved his initials into the trench wall next to a hundred others. Some of them are only half finished.

Someone in P-F7 asked Walter Arcadialoren about Halden. He talked for an hour. Nobody interrupted. A letter from home found Walter Arcadialoren before the night shift. Walter Arcadialoren folded it small and kept it close.

Walter Arcadialoren went over with the raiders and dropped into the Concord trench. Viktor Avery was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@yeah.itz.avery) Walter Arcadialoren jumped into the Concord trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Dorian "Spark" Cody. The Concord medics will be busy. (@cody13g) Walter Arcadialoren joined the raid, lay in a shell hole for an hour while the flares burned, and made it home. That counts as a good night out here. The letter for Walter Arcadialoren smelled faintly of soap. Walter Arcadialoren held it close for a long time before opening it.

Walter Arcadialoren tried to describe the smell of Halden and got as far as the bakery. Then the ration cart arrived. Someone at home had written the address three times, to be sure. The letter reached Walter Arcadialoren anyway.
big_fat_buddy: The new machine gunner is Marek "Brick" Buddy, once a railway porter from Brennmoor. The corporal asked if a railway porter was any use in a trench. Marek "Brick" Buddy said he would find out. Marek "Brick" Buddy walked the captured trenches of Verdel Ridge and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Marek "Brick" Buddy had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Walter Small crossed it, Marek "Brick" Buddy fired. Walter Small was grazed.
The section held a competition for the worst joke. Marek "Brick" Buddy won before reaching the end of his entry.

A clear shot from S-F17. Marek "Brick" Buddy grazed Jakub Lilsaint and slid back down below the parapet. Day 6: Hill 304 was lost. Marek "Brick" Buddy wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Marek "Brick" Buddy borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'.
Dawn watch. Marek "Brick" Buddy put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Walter Small, grazed.
Marek "Brick" Buddy saw shapes coming through the gap in the wire and fired along it. The shapes went to ground. One of them was Lucien "Shadow" Bananaman, grazed.

The gun crews at S-F17 and the next post fired together on a count of five. Caught between the two guns, Lucien "Shadow" Bananaman was badly wounded. Marek "Brick" Buddy fired at the sound of digging across the wire. The digging stopped. Florian "Button" Thebaileebla was grazed.

Marek "Brick" Buddy had kept the gun aimed at the enemy supply path for days. Tonight the supply party came, and Leopold "Mud" Studios was grazed. A trench mortar bomb landed in the next section of trench. The blast caught Marek "Brick" Buddy at S-F17 and the bearers came at a run. Blackwater Canal is lost. Marek "Brick" Buddy heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Someone moved Marek "Brick" Buddy's stretcher out of the doorway. It was the most anyone did for him all day, and he was grateful. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Marek "Brick" Buddy answered to number 190. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Marek "Brick" Buddy read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
The stretcher Marek "Brick" Buddy lay on for so long has a dent the shape of a body. Marek "Brick" Buddy is back at S-F17, and someone else is lying in that dent now.
The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Marek "Brick" Buddy waited for that to change. When it did, Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh was grazed.

A bullet hit Marek "Brick" Buddy's belt buckle at S-F17 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Bastian Ale of the Hegemony (@ale_3.7_2). Marek "Brick" Buddy saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at S-F17 and fired once. Walter Small was grazed.
Marek "Brick" Buddy returned to S-F17 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.
Marek "Brick" Buddy brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived.

Marek "Brick" Buddy did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Marek "Brick" Buddy fired back. Jakub Uwuandrea was grazed. A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Marek "Brick" Buddy aimed just below it. Marek Azstarlord was badly wounded.
burgosgeovanni: Gustav Burgosgeovan reached S-R17 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Gustav Burgosgeovan wrote to a sweetheart who has stopped writing that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

The whole squad at S-R17 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Gustav Burgosgeovan's bullet that found Karel "Doc" Gilbertjames, grazed. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Gustav Burgosgeovan kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Gustav Burgosgeovan tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.
Gustav Burgosgeovan rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Casimir Raphixdx was badly wounded at the far edge of no man's land.
A borrowed pencil wore down while Gustav Burgosgeovan was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first.

Gustav Burgosgeovan fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Clement Truth was badly wounded, and that rifle did not fire again tonight. The sergeant at S-R17 called out a range and a spot. Gustav Burgosgeovan was the only one who hit it. Walter Juizy was badly wounded.
Gustav Burgosgeovan raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-R17. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Valentin Cbeattie of the Hegemony (@cbeattie.1770).
Gustav Burgosgeovan returned to S-R17 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.
corporalstars: Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar stepped off the supply cart at S-F5 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar traded a lucky button for two cigarettes and immediately regretted it.
On sentry duty Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar watched the wire for six hours. Twice he thought the wire watched back.

Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar went out with the wiring party at S-F5. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. A letter from home reached Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar before dusk. Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar read it twice and slept a little easier. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony. Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar kept watch so that Dietrich Caydan could sleep. Then Dietrich kept watch so that Crow could. Neither slept.
A bullet clipped Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar's helmet at S-F5 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Zeno Tonyhuang of the Hegemony (@tonyhuang000).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar is whole again, or near enough for the line.

Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at S-F5 and fired once. Ulrich Pgallo was badly wounded. Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Zeno Tonyhuang crossed it, Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar fired. Zeno Tonyhuang was grazed.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar helped stack spare sandbags at S-F5. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

The whole squad at S-F5 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar's bullet that found Edmund Seanlively, grazed. A letter from home reached Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar before dusk. Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar read it twice and slept a little easier. Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 219. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In S-F5, Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
A bullet hit Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar's belt buckle at S-F5 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Dorian Caleb of the Hegemony (@ya_man_caleb).
The medic cut the last bandage off Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to S-F5 the same hour.
Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar carved his initials into the trench wall next to a hundred others. Some of them are only half finished.
Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection.
Nobody heard the Hegemony raiders cut the wire. Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar only heard boots on the duckboards at S-F5, then nothing but pain. Raider: Severin Ech of the Hegemony (@ech0_42).

A bullet struck Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar below the ribs at S-F5. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Dorian Man of the Hegemony (@democracy_man2144).
diegohernandez1296: Jonas Diegohernand came up on Day 10 carrying news from Esterhaus. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

Jonas Diegohernand and Matthias Thedeepnotes cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Jonas Diegohernand wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Jonas Diegohernand was hit through the stomach at P-F3. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Lucien Hateley of the Hegemony (@leighton_hateley). A single shot at P-F3. Jonas Diegohernand sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Lucien Hateley of the Hegemony (@leighton_hateley).
Karel Diegohernand put a cracked shaving mirror beside the bunk. Someone who had known Jonas Diegohernand helped clear the shelf without saying why.

Karel Diegohernand had Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni of the Hegemony in the sights at the Chalk Pits for a long second. Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni was lighting a pipe. Karel Diegohernand let the match burn all the way down.
A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Karel Diegohernand lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing.
Karel Diegohernand and Matthias Thedeepnotes carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.
Karel Diegohernand laughed at something nobody else had heard. Asked to share it, he admitted remembering a conversation from years ago.
A parcel from home held a comb. Karel Diegohernand has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought.
jdanieltzn: On Day 9 Anselm Jdanieltzn took a post at T-F19 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He shares cigarettes but never smokes, and the men liked him for it.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Anselm Jdanieltzn read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Anselm Jdanieltzn got a letter from Josef. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most. A letter from home reached Anselm Jdanieltzn before dusk. Anselm Jdanieltzn read it twice and slept a little easier. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Anselm Jdanieltzn watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Anselm Jdanieltzn turned a year older today. The whole squad sang for him, badly, and the cook found a candle. A letter from home reached Anselm Jdanieltzn before dusk. Anselm Jdanieltzn read it twice and slept a little easier.

Anselm Jdanieltzn wrote back to Josef and tore it up three times. The fourth version says almost nothing, which is how he knows it is the right one. A letter from home reached Anselm Jdanieltzn before dusk. Anselm Jdanieltzn read it twice and slept a little easier.

Anselm Jdanieltzn owes Albin Fossileyezd so many cigarettes that they stopped counting and started writing it down. The notebook is nearly full. A letter from home reached Anselm Jdanieltzn before dusk. Anselm Jdanieltzn read it twice and slept a little easier.

No post for Anselm Jdanieltzn this week. He checks the sack anyway, every day, and pretends he was only looking for tobacco. A letter from home reached Anselm Jdanieltzn before dusk. Anselm Jdanieltzn read it twice and slept a little easier.

Anselm Jdanieltzn was hit through the chest at T-F19. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Hugo Boi of the Hegemony (@m4sk3dn3k0boi). A single shot at T-F19. Anselm Jdanieltzn sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Hugo Boi of the Hegemony (@m4sk3dn3k0boi).
Ulrich Jdanieltzn put a pressed cornflower beside the bunk. Someone who had known Anselm Jdanieltzn helped clear the shelf without saying why.

Ulrich Jdanieltzn found water collecting beneath the gun's cover. He sketched a small shelter and took the drawing to the stores. A letter reached Ulrich Jdanieltzn in the rain. The ink ran a little, but every word that mattered was still there.
jimbeachball25: The draft reached R-S2 on Day 8. Bram Jimbeachball was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
Bram Jimbeachball spent the afternoon delousing his shirt over a candle. The lice won on points.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In R-S2, Bram Jimbeachball listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Bram Jimbeachball found a photograph in the mud of no man's land: an old man with a dog, and a name on the back that is not from his side of the wire. Bram Jimbeachball got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 579. The men who came later will ask about it. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Bram Jimbeachball looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
The bread had frozen at the edges. Bram Jimbeachball held it near the stove and defended the space with both elbows.
The men argued about whether fish sleep. Bram Jimbeachball said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know.
Bram Jimbeachball keeps the photograph in his pocket next to a tin whistle. He says he will give it back after the war. Nobody asks to whom.

Bram Jimbeachball was hit in the foot through his boot at R-S2. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Wendel "Spark" Floooring of the Hegemony (@carpet.floooring). Bram Jimbeachball was killed at R-S2 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Wendel "Spark" Floooring of the Hegemony (@carpet.floooring).
Cyril Jimbeachball took the same post at R-S2 where Bram Jimbeachball stood. He found his brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
Cyril Jimbeachball and Dietrich Ripvanwinkle spent an hour hunting rats with a bucket and a piece of cheese. Score at dusk: rats 4, soldiers 1.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Cyril Jimbeachball's ear at R-S2 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Wendel Jesus of the Hegemony (@jesus.gr9).
jmw094: Walter "Button" Jmw was a farmhand in Northwick until the posters went up. He came to R-R12 with a lock of hair in a matchbox, and within a day the whole squad knew that he never takes off his scarf.

Across from R-R12, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Walter "Button" Jmw saw it. Nils "Mud" Zzz was badly wounded. The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Walter "Button" Jmw looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Walter "Button" Jmw was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Walter "Button" Jmw is number 876. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Walter "Button" Jmw wrote to a grandmother who prays for both armies that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Walter "Button" Jmw cleaned grit from the rifle bolt with a scrap of cloth. The scrap was once the clean part of a shirt.
Walter "Button" Jmw held the mirror while Henrik "Button" Fish shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.
A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Walter "Button" Jmw lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing.
Walter "Button" Jmw fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Matthias "Shadow" Slush, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-R12 and grazed Walter "Button" Jmw's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Teodor Casualkriegs of the Hegemony (@casualkriegsman). A clear shot from R-R12. Walter "Button" Jmw gravely wounded Quentin Jewnipers and slid back down below the parapet.
The medic looked at Walter "Button" Jmw's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to R-R12. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
kim_jong_un_kieran: On Day 9 Karel "Mole" Kieran took a post at Q-F12 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He knows every star by name, and the men liked him for it.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Karel "Mole" Kieran was hit hard in the fight at Q-F12 before anyone could fire. The raider was Gideon Lfie of the Concord. Raider: Gideon Lfie of the Concord (@4lf__ie). The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Karel "Mole" Kieran helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly. A letter from home found Karel "Mole" Kieran before the night shift. Karel "Mole" Kieran folded it small and kept it close.

A single shot from across the wire hit Karel "Mole" Kieran in the thigh at Q-F12. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Silas Shorlock of the Concord (@shorlock115). Karel "Mole" Kieran looked over the parapet at Q-F12 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Silas Shorlock of the Concord (@shorlock115).

Jonas Kieran had heard about Karel "Mole" Kieran's courage. At Q-F12, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting. Grey Mill has been won. Jonas Kieran listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Jonas Kieran across the shin at Q-F12. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Pavel Olivas of the Concord (@joseph.olivas.3762). A letter from home found Jonas Kieran before the night shift. Jonas Kieran folded it small and kept it close.

The medic looked at Jonas Kieran's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to Q-F12. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows. A letter from home found Jonas Kieran before the night shift. Jonas Kieran folded it small and kept it close.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet went through Jonas Kieran's upper arm at Q-F12 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. A letter from home found Jonas Kieran before the night shift. Jonas Kieran folded it small and kept it close.
Every bed was taken and every medic was busy. Jonas Kieran died waiting. The men at Q-F12 have not stopped talking about it.
The House of Kieran sent Ivo Kieran after Jonas Kieran. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.

Ivo Kieran counted the steps of the Concord sentry, waited for the turn, and went in. Dorian "Ash" Martin never saw the shovel coming. (@martin.el12) Machine-gun fire swept Q-F12. Ivo Kieran took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Pavel Olivas of the Concord (@joseph.olivas.3762). Ivo Kieran died on a stretcher outside the aid post, still waiting for a bed. The medics had nothing left to give him.
Walter Kieran joined Q-F12 under the shadow of Ivo Kieran's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.

Walter Kieran borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing. A thin letter reached Walter Kieran. Only five lines long, and Walter Kieran knew every one of them by heart before supper.
krut4s3k: Albin "Tin" Krut arrived at U-F11 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.

Albin "Tin" Krut stood at the parapet at dawn with the rest of U-F11, bayonet fixed, staring into the grey. Nothing came. Nothing came yesterday, either. Grey Mill is lost. Albin "Tin" Krut heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Albin "Tin" Krut opened a parcel addressed in unfamiliar handwriting. A note inside said the usual writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first.
Albin "Tin" Krut smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Hugo "Mud" Rambam came out for a cup and was grazed.
Isidor Eccentricred lent Albin "Tin" Krut a razor. It came back sharper, with a new handle carved from an old tent peg.

Albin "Tin" Krut was found at the bottom of the trench at U-F11, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Bastian Nouniquetag of the Hegemony (@nouniquetag). Albin "Tin" Krut was killed at U-F11 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Bastian Nouniquetag of the Hegemony (@nouniquetag).
The House of Krut sent Clement "Parson" Krut after Albin "Tin" Krut. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.

A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Clement "Parson" Krut across the shin at U-F11. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Cyril Drawtoss of the Hegemony (@drawtoss). A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Clement "Parson" Krut shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Zeno "Hollow" Kagkhunthod, was badly wounded.

A single shot from across the wire hit Clement "Parson" Krut in the thigh at U-F11. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Isidor "Rabbit" Png of the Hegemony (@sevr.png). Clement "Parson" Krut was hit at U-F11 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Isidor "Rabbit" Png of the Hegemony (@sevr.png).
The papers say Viktor "Spark" Krut. The sergeant says he has his older brother's eyes. Clement "Parson" Krut's eyes. Nobody in U-F11 argues.
masudkainath_evan: Arno Evan walked into N-F5 on Day 15 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could. Arno Evan reported for duty as a sniper. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.
Arno Evan was on watch at N-F5 when the night raid hit. The men found Arno Evan at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Severin Ndersen of the Concord (@mr_4ndersen).
The papers connected Silas Evan to Arno Evan. The men took longer to learn Silas Evan's own habits, but they made the effort.

A bullet found Silas Evan at N-F5, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Hugo "Parson" Wpjarrell of the Concord (@wpjarrell07). There was no bed for Silas Evan. He lay on a stretcher outside, wrapped in a coat, listening to the guns.
mindblot55: Dietrich Mindblot joined the replacements on Day 9. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.

Dietrich Mindblot fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Rafael Aquaman, grazed. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Dietrich Mindblot kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

A round went through Dietrich Mindblot's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Ivo "Rabbit" Beck of the Hegemony (@brandon_marc_beck). A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Dietrich Mindblot is number 976. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Dietrich Mindblot wrote to a younger sister who sends drawings that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Dietrich Mindblot returned to R-R2 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.
Dietrich Mindblot counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Isidor Hohlmike was badly wounded.
Dietrich Mindblot began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter.
Dietrich Mindblot raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-R2. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Dietrich Marcusho of the Hegemony (@marcusho64).
Three days with a bandage, and Dietrich Mindblot is back at R-R2. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.

A bullet found Dietrich Mindblot at R-R2, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Ulrich Unstoppable of the Hegemony (@mr.unstoppable213). Outside the aid post, Dietrich Mindblot lies on a stretcher among the others. The orderlies step over him and say soon.
mmbigfanno1: Day 14. The corporal put Bastian Mmbigfanno beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Bastian Mmbigfanno read a theatre review while peeling supper.
A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Bastian Mmbigfanno. The men named it Old Tom and said it had chosen him.
Old Tom the crow follows Bastian Mmbigfanno along the trench now. When Old Tom flies off, men duck. They are usually right to.
operatortex145: Yann Operatortex arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a frozen apple and a borrowed coat two sizes too big. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Yann Operatortex wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Yann Operatortex was made Lance Corporal after keeping the section together under fire. He asked that the rest of the section be mentioned too.
The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Yann Operatortex fired, and Roland "Shadow" Fith was grazed.
A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Yann Operatortex pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified.

The gun at V-F10 jammed twice and fired once. Once was enough: Oskar Dreams, grazed. Yann Operatortex fired short bursts at the gap in the enemy wire, the way the sergeant taught. Yann Ethan was grazed trying to cross it.
Two men fed the belt while Yann Operatortex held the gun steady on the enemy parapet. When they stopped, Leopold "Tin" Jaxk was badly wounded.
Yann Operatortex raised his head for a heartbeat too long at V-F10. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Dietrich Notceyshhauc of the Hegemony (@notceyshhauceyban).
pineapplejamming: The new rifleman is Emil "Smokes" Pineapplejam, once a lamplighter from Stoneyford. The corporal asked if a lamplighter was any use in a trench. Emil "Smokes" Pineapplejam said he would find out.

Emil "Smokes" Pineapplejam and Norbert Bwk tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco. From Hill 304 the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Emil "Smokes" Pineapplejam wrote to five brothers, all on other fronts that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Dawn watch. Emil "Smokes" Pineapplejam put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Jakub "Hollow" Hill, grazed.
A clear shot from R-F22. Emil "Smokes" Pineapplejam gravely wounded Jakub "Hollow" Hill and slid back down below the parapet.
Emil "Smokes" Pineapplejam tried to dry a page near the stove. The paper survived, but the message now has the smell of toasted bread.
Emil "Smokes" Pineapplejam spent the afternoon delousing his shirt over a candle. The lice won on points.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Emil "Smokes" Pineapplejam stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Someone in R-F22 asked Emil "Smokes" Pineapplejam about Stoneyford. He talked for an hour. Nobody interrupted. Emil "Smokes" Pineapplejam got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 347. The men who came later will ask about it. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Emil "Smokes" Pineapplejam read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Emil "Smokes" Pineapplejam opened a parcel addressed in unfamiliar handwriting. A note inside said the usual writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first.
Emil "Smokes" Pineapplejam was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Lucien Tzukitolotl was gravely wounded.
An enemy patrol scattered in front of R-F22. Emil "Smokes" Pineapplejam fired at the last man to run. Oskar Nathan was grazed.
Emil "Smokes" Pineapplejam did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Emil "Smokes" Pineapplejam fired back. Arno Shitsherlock was grazed.

Nobody heard the Hegemony raiders cut the wire. Emil "Smokes" Pineapplejam only heard boots on the duckboards at R-F22, then nothing but pain. Raider: Dietrich Rudransh of the Hegemony (@11.rudransh).
Emil "Smokes" Pineapplejam rejoined the squad at R-F22. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
ssherman0: Cyril Ssherman found a place in S-S3 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.

Cyril Ssherman stacked spare duckboards beside the junction. Within an hour, the stack had become a bench, a table and an argument. Mail came up the line with a letter for Cyril Ssherman. Cyril Ssherman read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Cyril Ssherman went over with the raiders and dropped into the Hegemony trench. Viktor Thervvival was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@thervvival_) Cyril Ssherman came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot. Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Cyril Ssherman wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

A medic brought Cyril Ssherman half a cup of soup and a promise. The soup was real. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Cyril Ssherman is number 548. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. After the loss of Grey Mill, Cyril Ssherman helped stack spare sandbags at S-S3. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
A medic stopped by Cyril Ssherman's stretcher every few hours for a week. Today the medic found it empty. Cyril Ssherman had gone back to S-S3.
Fog hid the far end of S-S3. Cyril Ssherman kept counting the turns so as not to walk past the dugout.
A shell splinter the size of a fist hit Cyril Ssherman at S-S3. He is alive and he is in pain, and he needs a bed.
Cyril Ssherman lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk.
Cyril Ssherman healed on a stretcher under a canvas sheet, with the bearers stepping over him day and night. He thanked each one by name before leaving.
A bullet clipped Cyril Ssherman's helmet at S-S3 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Casimir Dunkmyanactu of the Hegemony (@dunkmyanactual).
staryfins: By the time Leopold Staryfins reached S-F22, the war was 4 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

The listening post reported scraping beyond the wire. Leopold Staryfins waited through an hour of it before a loose stake was found. The Hegemony flag went up over Hill 304. Leopold Staryfins did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Dawn watch. Leopold Staryfins put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Teodor Triplejjj, grazed.
Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Leopold Staryfins changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument.
Leopold Staryfins has fired hundreds of rounds into the dark. Today one of them found someone: Nils Mas, grazed.
Two shots, one miss. The second found Isidor Jacksondeehr, grazed. Leopold Staryfins cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not.

Fresh from training, Leopold Staryfins still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Anselm "Mole" Kjwthe, grazed. The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Leopold Staryfins helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Leopold Staryfins borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Leopold Staryfins answered to number 326. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Leopold Staryfins during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Leopold Staryfins measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together.
Leopold Staryfins has asked three carrying parties for the next instalment. So far, the search has produced racing results and an advertisement for boots.
A rat stole Leopold Staryfins's cheese ration while he watched. He let it. The rat looked hungrier.
Leopold Staryfins had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Severin Guy crossed it, Leopold Staryfins fired. Severin Guy was badly wounded.

At S-F22 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Leopold Staryfins won the bet. Marek Triskit was badly wounded. Leopold Staryfins fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Gideon Mirwik was grazed. Leopold Staryfins ate breakfast without a word.

Leopold Staryfins saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at S-F22 and fired once. Silas Lakam was badly wounded. Shrapnel at the Drowned Farm. Leopold Staryfins walked to the medics on his own feet and asked for a cigarette before the stitches.
yummygraingoestomytummy: On Day 8, Marek "Mud" Yummygraingo arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.

A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Marek "Mud" Yummygraingo. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer. The snipers took Marek "Mud" Yummygraingo in on a busy morning in R-S2. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.

Marek "Mud" Yummygraingo crawled through a gap in the Concord wire and slid into their trench. Arno Isaacburston reached for a rifle. Marek "Mud" Yummygraingo was faster with the sharpened shovel. (@isaacburston) A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at R-S2. Marek "Mud" Yummygraingo was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Clement "Owl" Audio of the Concord (@dean.anthony.audio).

The House of Yummygraingo sent another. Felix Yummygraingo, father of Marek "Mud" Yummygraingo, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence. The new duty roster listed Felix Yummygraingo as a sniper. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.

Felix Yummygraingo felt a hard tug at his hip at R-S2. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Felix Ryanstebbins of the Concord (@ryanstebbins1). Felix Yummygraingo got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 571. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Felix Yummygraingo helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Felix Yummygraingo's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
Felix Yummygraingo reached up to fix a sandbag at R-S2 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Florian Crdw of the Concord (@axel.crdw).

Felix Yummygraingo was hit twice at R-S2, once in the leg and once in the side. The second wound is the bad one. Shot by Dietrich "Button" Cake of the Concord (@lonnor_cake). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Felix Yummygraingo fell at R-S2 and never moved again. Shot by Dietrich "Button" Cake of the Concord (@lonnor_cake).
Another member of the House of Yummygraingo reached the line: Henrik "Ghost" Yummygraingo. He asked where Felix Yummygraingo had slept, then chose a different corner.
Henrik "Ghost" Yummygraingo noticed a loophole that had been dark for days. He watched it until dusk and wrote down what changed.
Henrik "Ghost" Yummygraingo fired at the enemy dawn watch from R-S2. Henrik Ami was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Henrik "Ghost" Yummygraingo changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument.
